episodeTitle.en: How to win when software is not a moat | Evan Spiegel (Snapchat CEO)
episodeTitle.zh: 当软件不再是护城河时如何取胜 | 埃文·斯皮格尔（Snapchat CEO）

guestBioOfficial.en: Evan Spiegel, the co-founder and CEO of Snap, is one of the very few people in the world who has successfully built and scaled a lasting consumer social product. Snapchat has nearly 1 billion MAUs, and Evan and his team invented some of the most important consumer products and features, including Stories, AR glasses, swipe-based navigation, the camera as the primary UX, and a lot more. *In our in-depth conversation, we discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: Snap的联合创始人兼CEO埃文·斯皮格尔是世界上为数不多成功打造并扩展持久消费级社交产品的人之一。Snapchat拥有近10亿月活用户，埃文及其团队发明了许多重要的消费级产品和功能，包括Stories、AR眼镜、滑动式导航、以摄像头为核心的用户体验等。在我们的深度对话中，我们将探讨：

title.en: How to win when software is not a moat | Evan Spiegel (Snapchat CEO)
title.zh: 当软件不再是护城河时如何取胜 | 埃文·斯皮格尔（Snapchat CEO）

summary.en: Evan argues the hardest part of consumer products isn't product-market fit but distribution, and that Snap's relentless innovation (Stories, AR glasses, swipe navigation) comes from a deliberately tiny design team that presents work on day one. He reflects on 15 years of being copied by the industry and why 'software is not a moat'—a lesson the AI world is now rediscovering. Framing the year as a 'crucible moment,' he stresses that humanity, not technology, dictates adoption, and warns of major societal pushback against careless AI deployment.
summary.zh: Evan 认为消费品最难的部分不是产品市场契合，而是分发；Snap 持续不断的创新（Stories、AR 眼镜、滑动导航）来自一支刻意保持精简、入职第一天就要展示作品的设计团队。他回顾了 15 年来被全行业抄袭的经历，以及为何“软件不是护城河”——这正是如今 AI 界正在重新学到的教训。他把这一年称为“熔炉时刻”，强调决定技术能否被采用的终究是人，而非技术本身，并警示对草率部署 AI 将会出现巨大的社会反弹。
